name: loadwise
description: Loadwise — load management for the time between physiotherapy appointments.

scripts.check:engine: npm run typecheck --workspace=engine && npm run coverage --workspace=engine
scripts.check:web: npm run test --workspace=web && npm run typecheck --workspace=web && npm run check:boundary --workspace=web

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=engine && npm run typecheck --workspace=web

scripts.check:full: npm run check:engine && npm run build && npm run check:web
